name: peer-egress-failure-v1
notes: 消费端在命中 egress 规则的流走不通时写回本机 TUN 的包。不写，应用只能等自己的超时——TCP 要一分钟以上——而规则其实在正常工作；写了，应用立刻失败、自行重试，这就是规范里「不能无缝恢复的流明确失败」。
resetOnPurge：消费端自己清掉的流（出口离线、规则改动），应用没有发来可以回应的段，复位从消费端记住的东西造出来：应用最后一次的确认号就是它的接收窗口起点，现代协议栈（RFC 5961）只在这个序号上接受复位而不发质询 ACK。RST|ACK，确认号为应用发到的位置。
resetOnPacket：消费端拒绝转发的段，按 RFC 793 回应，与出口用户态栈同一条规则：带 ACK 的段，复位的序号取它的确认号；不带 ACK 的段（新连接的 SYN），复位带 ACK，确认号覆盖它的序号空间（SYN、FIN 各占一个）。
unreachableOnDatagram：消费端拒绝转发的数据报，回 ICMP 目的不可达、主机不可达（类型 3 代码 1），引用原包的 IP 头和前 8 字节——正是 UDP 头，协议栈靠它把错误对到 socket 上。
只在「出口不可用」时写回：出口离线、尚未在线、流被清掉。发送失败（会话正在重建）不写，那条流可能还能恢复；block 规则不写，它是丢弃；不承载的协议不写。
IPv4 头固定：无标识、无标志、TTL 64；TCP 窗口 0，无选项。三端产出的字节必须完全一致。

cases.name: established-flow
cases.note: The application acknowledged up to 700001 and sent up to 1233; the reset's sequence is its receive-next, which RFC 5961 stacks accept without a challenge.

cases.name: flow-after-the-handshake-only
cases.note: Only the handshake happened: ISS 1000, so the SYN advanced seq to 1001; the egress's ISN 0 was acknowledged as 1.

cases.name: sequence-numbers-near-the-wrap
cases.note: Written as unsigned 32-bit values; a runtime that carries them signed writes the same bytes.

cases.name: syn-for-a-new-connection
cases.note: The egress is unavailable when the application connects. RST|ACK acknowledging the SYN is what a SYN-SENT socket accepts; the application sees connection refused.

cases.name: data-on-a-flow-that-was-purged
cases.note: The segment carries ACK, so the reset's sequence is that acknowledgement: the application's own receive-next.

cases.name: fin-after-the-egress-went-away
cases.note: Same rule; the FIN's own sequence number does not enter into it.

cases.name: bare-syn-with-payload
cases.note: TCP Fast Open puts data on the SYN; the acknowledgement covers the SYN and the data.

cases.name: dns-query
cases.note: The quoted part is the header plus the first eight bytes of the datagram: the UDP header, which is what lets the stack match the error to the socket.

cases.name: short-datagram
cases.note: Ten bytes of UDP in all. The quote is still the header plus eight bytes, which is exactly the UDP header; the two payload bytes are not quoted.
